lead.headline: Swift's 17-Bank Tokenized Deposit Pilot
lead.tldr: Traditional finance is moving from conceptual tokenization to active ledger pilots, while crypto VCs like Paradigm are diversifying into AI to hedge against sector-specific volatility.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Tarun Chitra's Gauntlet raises $125 million Series C from sole investor SBI Holdings
top_signals.summary: Gauntlet, founded by Tarun Chitra, has raised $125 million in a Series C funding round. The investment was provided solely by SBI Holdings to support the growth of DeFi, tokenization, and vaults.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The concentration of a $125M Series C in a single investor (SBI Holdings) suggests a strategic alignment between Japanese institutional capital and DeFi risk management.

top_signals.title: Swift launches blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit pilot with 17 banks
top_signals.summary: Swift has launched a blockchain-based ledger to facilitate a pilot program for 24/7 cross-border payments. The initiative involves 17 banks utilizing tokenized deposits to streamline international transfers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Swift's move validates tokenized deposits as the primary vehicle for institutional cross-border settlement over volatile native assets.

top_signals.title: SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilot31m, SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilotSWIFT launched its new blockchain ledger that will host a tokenized bank deposit pilot for 17 major banks seeking faster cross-border payments.
top_signals.summary: SWIFT has launched a new blockchain ledger to facilitate a tokenized deposit pilot involving 17 major banks. The initiative aims to significantly increase the speed and efficiency of cross-border payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The scale of 17 participating banks indicates that the industry is prioritizing interoperability and speed in the legacy payment stack.

top_signals.title: Crypto VC Paradigm raises $1.2B to push into AICrypto venture firm Paradigm is widening its investment gaze toward AI and other frontier industries with its latest fund.
top_signals.summary: Crypto venture capital firm Paradigm has raised a new fund totaling $1.2 billion. The firm intends to use this capital to expand its investment focus into AI and other frontier technology industries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Paradigm's $1.2B fund expansion into AI signals a broader trend of crypto-native capital seeking alpha in the intersection of compute and cryptography.

top_signals.title: Phantom, Hyperliquid ask CFTC to modernize rules for onchain derivatives21m, Phantom, Hyperliquid ask CFTC to modernize rules for onchain derivatives
top_signals.summary: Phantom and Hyperliquid have formally petitioned the CFTC to modernize regulatory frameworks for onchain derivatives. The move aims to create a legal pathway for decentralized platforms to operate within US regulatory boundaries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Direct petitions from Phantom and Hyperliquid to the CFTC mark a shift toward proactive regulatory engagement for onchain derivatives.

on_the_radar.title: MARA shares surge after 2 GW Texas infrastructure deal expands AI ambitions28m
on_the_radar.summary: MARA has entered a deal to expand its Texas infrastructure by 2 GW to support its ambitions in AI and Bitcoin mining. This strategic move led to a surge in the company's share price.

on_the_radar.title: PayPal seeks to increase use of PYUSD stablecoin with native issuance on Polygon
on_the_radar.summary: PayPal is expanding the utility of its PYUSD stablecoin by enabling native issuance on the Polygon network. The stablecoin will also be integrated into Polygon's Open Money Stack to increase adoption.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC Chair Selig warns regulators will end up 'writing all the rules' for crypto if Clarity Act stalls
on_the_radar.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig warned that regulatory agencies will be forced to establish their own rules for the crypto industry if Congress does not pass the Clarity Act. This highlights the tension between legislative action and regulatory oversight in the US.

on_the_radar.title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins6m
on_the_radar.summary: Sony Bank has received approval from US regulators to issue stablecoins. This move signals a significant step toward integrating traditional banking infrastructure with digital asset issuance.

on_the_radar.title: INTERPOL-led global fraud crackdown arrests over 5,800, uncovers crypto laundering network tied to $122.5 million wallet
on_the_radar.summary: INTERPOL led a global crackdown on fraud resulting in over 5,800 arrests and the discovery of a sophisticated crypto laundering network. The operation highlighted the use of cross-chain swaps to obscure illicit funds, specifically identifying one wallet that processed $122.5 million in ten months.

on_the_radar.title: Hyundai Card completes its first real-world stablecoin pilot with Avalanche, Tether
on_the_radar.summary: Hyundai Card has successfully completed its first real-world stablecoin pilot utilizing Avalanche and Tether. The company is now expanding its efforts with a second Proof of Concept (PoC) involving Visa and Circle.

on_the_radar.title: AscendEX crypto exchange shuts down, no assurance on user payouts
on_the_radar.summary: AscendEX crypto exchange has officially ceased operations as of July 1, citing a combination of regulatory, financial, and operational difficulties. There is currently no assurance regarding the payout of user funds.

on_the_radar.title: Injective NPM Package Hacked to Steal Crypto Wallet Keys
on_the_radar.summary: A compromised npm package associated with Injective was discovered stealing cryptocurrency wallet keys. The security firm Socket identified the breach, highlighting a growing trend of supply chain attacks targeting Web3 developers.

linkedin_post: I keep coming back to the Swift pilot involving 17 banks. While the market often focuses on retail adoption, the real movement is happening in the plumbing of cross-border payments. Using a blockchain ledger for tokenized deposits isn't a pivot to DeFi; it is a pragmatic upgrade to the legacy settlement process. When you combine this with Gauntlet raising $125M from SBI Holdings, the signal is clear: institutional interest is shifting toward the actual utility of tokenization and risk management rather than speculative assets. I'd watch how these tokenized deposits interact with existing liquidity pools, as this is where the actual friction in global finance remains. The focus is now on efficiency and speed, not just the novelty of the ledger.
